messages:
lina_sales: Hey team — AcmeRetail POC is getting good throughput but the customer sees sporadic 502/504-ish failures and long tail responses from our JS client behind their corp proxy. Can we swarm?
pranav_se: Seen this before. Likely a combination of proxy idle timeouts + client keepalive not set. Any logs from the SDK side?
aj_devex: They sent this snippet from their browserless node app:
```
fetch error: connect EAI_AGAIN proxy.internal.corp:3128
request to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate failed, reason: socket hang up
```
molly_support: Also seeing a few TCP RSTs in the tcpdump we asked for. Looks like the proxy or firewall is tearing idle connections.
lina_sales: Customer asks if this is an SDK bug — they’re evaluating Dedicated. Also wants to confirm if there’s any price impact if we recommend connecting via a dedicated NAT/bastion.
pranav_se: Not an SDK bug per se. Two-pronged fix: 1) client-side keepalives/timeouts + better retry/backoff, 2) infra-side: suggest a short-lived connection pooling or a TCP keepalive on the proxy.
aj_devex: For TS SDK quick patch we suggested:
```js
// node http agent
const agent = new http.Agent({ keepAlive: true, keepAliveMsecs: 30000, maxSockets: 50 });
fetch(url, { agent, timeout: 60000 });
```
Also recommend setting env vars: `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY`, and add `NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,.internal.corp` for internal endpoints.
molly_support: For Python they can use:
```py
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
s = requests.Session()
adapter = HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=20, pool_maxsize=100, max_retries=Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=0.5))
s.mount('https://', adapter)
resp = s.post(url, json=payload, timeout=(5,60))
```
set socket options: `socket.setdefaulttimeout(60)` and enable TCP keepalive on the OS if possible.
pranav_se: One more: corporate proxies sometimes do aggressive DNS caching or return EAI_AGAIN when upstream DNS is flaky. Ask them to try forcing IPv4 or adding the Redwood endpoint to their internal DNS/hosts as a short-term test.
lina_sales: They also asked about our recommended timeout values for POC — what do we tell them?
aj_devex: Recommend connect timeout 5s, read timeout 60s for streaming calls, and client retry with jitter (max 3 attempts). For streaming, avoid aggressive retries because it can re-run prompts.
molly_support: If the proxy terminates long-lived TLS sessions, advise them to increase keepalive or use a lightweight outbound NAT/Bastion that preserves upstream connections. There is some cost for a dedicated NAT but usually small compared to token spend — we should provide an example cost delta.
infra-bot: deploy:link https://console.redwood.ai/dedicated/nats/plan-estimator — estimated monthly cost for small bastion: $120-$180 (depends on region).
lina_sales: Thanks — send that estimator link and a short checklist we can hand to their infra team. Also they want confirmation for security questionnaire: will a bastion require additional SOC docs?
pranav_se: No extra SOC doc just for a NAT. If they want Private deployment (VPC) then we provide the usual SOC2/ISO artifacts via enterprise agreements.
aj_devex: I'll paste a short checklist for them to try before shifting infra:
- Set HTTP(S)_PROXY/NO_PROXY correctly on app hosts
- Enable client keepalive (agent or socket options)
- Use sensible connect/read timeouts (5s/60s) and exponential backoff with jitter
- For Python, use requests.Session with adapter pool and limited retries
- Consider forcing IPv4 or adding host entry to test DNS flakiness
- If still unstable, use an outbound bastion/NAT to avoid proxy timeouts

lina_sales: Perfect — can one of you ping the account team with the checklist and cost link? I’ll also note pricing impact in the POC brief.
molly_support: Pinged account and added a short note in the POC doc. If they can run a simple repro with `curl --http1.1 -v` behind proxy and capture timing we can triage more precisely.
pranav_se: TL;DR for customer: not an SDK crash — proxy/TCP/DNS are most likely. Try the checklist and send logs (client errors + tcpdump). We’ll join if they want a debug session. :handshake:
lina_sales: Thanks all — I scheduled a 30m debugging call with AcmeRetail tomorrow 10am PT. Please join if you can.
